title: Shivchem Agro IPO Details
intro:
Shivchem Agro IPO is a book build issue of ₹14.01 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 22.60 lakh shares of ₹14.01 crore.

Shivchem Agro IPO opens for subscription on Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Sep 30, 2026. The allotment for the Shivchem Agro IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 1, 2026. Shivchem Agro IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 6, 2026.

Shivchem Agro IPO is set issue price band at ₹59 to ₹62 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,48,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,72,000.

Shannon Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Nikunj Stock Brokers Ltd.

Refer to Shivchem Agro IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in September 2021, Shivchem Agro Limited is an agrochemical company engaged in the manufacturing, stocking, distribution and sale of agricultural formulations.The Company offers a diversified portfolio of insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, plant growth regulators, rodenticides and fertilizers. As of the date of the Red Herring Prospectus, the Company is licensed to manufacture 176 agrochemical products, including 88 insecticides, 40 fungicides, 37 herbicides, 8 plant growth regulators and 3 rodenticides. It also has authorization for manufacturing 82 fertilizers, of which it currently manufactures 8.

The Company is licensed to sell, stock, exhibit and distribute its products across eight states in India and, as of March 31, 2026, had 685 distributors supported by five godowns. Its manufacturing facility in Jhajjar is equipped with machinery for agrochemical production and includes an Effluent Treatment Plant and Wet Scrubber Unit for managing wastewater and air emissions.

The Company is ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22000:2018 and ISO 31000:2018 certified and provides crop protection solutions through the manufacturing, supply and distribution of solid and liquid formulations. Its product portfolio is supported by on-field product demonstrations and a distribution network serving multiple agricultural markets.
As of March 31, 2026, the Company had 66 permanent employees, with the largest workforce deployed across sales and marketing, manufacturing and operations, accounts and finance, and field functions.
strengths: Manufacturing Facility with Diverse Product Capabilities.

faqs.question: How to apply in Shivchem Agro IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Shivchem Agro IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Shivchem Agro IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Shivchem Agro IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Shivchem Agro IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Shivchem Agro IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Shivchem Agro IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Shivchem Agro IPO will be done on Thursday, October 1, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Oct 5, 2026 . Check the Shivchem Agro IPO allotment status .
